data.title: ai.txt
data.content: A generative tool that creates an ai.txt file that selectively restricts or permits the use of your site's content for commercial AI mining and training. It works within Spawning's development agenda to produce tools that improve the transparency and consent of other, widespread AI tools, by assisting creators to opt in or out of wider AI training.

data.title: Pol.is
data.content: Described as 'a real-time system for gathering, analyzing and understanding what large groups of people think in their own words, enabled by advanced statistics and machine learning', Pol.is is an open source tool for new survey and reconciliation formats. Alongside open source code, a substantial effort is made to populate a knowledge base that explains the protocols employed, comprehensibly but in depth. It is deployable across many contexts and open to community contributions and feedback. Its artistic potential, for the production of work, collective structures and institutional governance are wide-ranging.

data.title: Claude
data.content: Claude is Anthropic's LLM. Its model and training data are unavailable for examination, though they emphasise the importance of safety to their approach and their research on alignment on their website.

data.title: LAION-5B
data.content: A dataset of 5,85 billion CLIP-filtered image-text pairs, 14x bigger than LAION-400M, previously the biggest openly accessible image-text dataset in the world. Though open source, this dataset has sparked controversy in its use of public domain resources without explicit consent from their creators. It is widely used and discussed, and can be searched using Spawning's 'Have I Been Trained?' tool.

data.title: Scribble to Art
data.content: Proprietary tool which turns line drawings into generative images. Potentially useful for specific contexts, there is little accompanying information to evaluate the tool's development.
